verdict.rationale: CockroachDB is a distributed SQL database, not an agent or AI host application, so consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers is outside its product role. The evidence shows only that CockroachDB Cloud runs an MCP server that external AI tools connect to. That is the server role and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
